description: Ticket 3.19: build eval cases beyond the readiness file's workshop examples (`npm run eval -- build` runs them after those, as examples 5 and 6). Same shape as platform/api/eval/readiness.json; the category names the media the app keeps: `photo` (the build must show a photo button, a file input accepting images, and a tag filter (a list, buttons or a field named with "filter", "show", "only", "browse" or "search" and "tag", or a list starting with "All"); signed in, a photo picked there is uploaded, its address saved in the data and shown) or `voice` (a Record button and a topic filter, the same way; signed in, the recording made with the phone's recorder, which Chromium opens in the apps' sandbox, is uploaded, saved in the data and shown in an audio player). Ticket 3.22: then two AI cases (`npm run eval -- build --example 7` and `8`), also in the readiness suite since ticket 3.23 taught the readiness prompt the AI tasks: `ai-tags` (a gallery that suggests tags with workshopData.ai.tagPhoto) and `ai-receipt` (an expense app that reads a receipt with workshopData.ai.readPhoto). Signed in, on the in-memory workshop whose AI route gives fixed answers (no Bedrock), a photo (for the receipt, a synthetic receipt drawn in Chromium) is picked; the app's code must call the helper, ask the AI for the photo, show the suggestion, save nothing holding it before the visitor accepts, and save it once the visitor presses Save.

examples.name: drawing gallery with tags (photos)
examples.spec:
# Drawing Gallery

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  gallery[Gallery] -->|take a photo| add[Add a photo]
  add -->|saves the photo and its tags| photos[(Photos)]
  photos -->|filter by tag| gallery
```

## What it does
A shared gallery of the team's drawings. Someone signed in to the workshop takes a photo of a drawing with the phone camera (or picks one from the phone), gives it one or more tags, and saves it. The gallery shows the photos as thumbnails, newest first, and a tag filter shows only the photos with the chosen tag.

## Screens
- Gallery: thumbnails of all photos, newest first, each with its tags, and a tag filter above them (All, or one tag).
- Add a photo: a button to take or pick a photo, a field for its tags separated by commas, and a Save button.

## Data it keeps
- Photos: the photo, its tags and the date it was added.

examples.name: voice messages by topic (recordings)
examples.spec:
# Voice Notes

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  messages[Messages] -->|record a message| record[Record]
  record -->|saves the recording and its topic| notes[(Voice messages)]
  notes -->|filter by topic| messages
```

## What it does
Short voice messages for the team. Someone signed in to the workshop records a voice message with the phone (up to 5 minutes), picks its topic from a short list (Ideas, Questions, News), and saves it. The messages screen lists the messages, newest first, each with its topic and a player, and a topic filter shows only one topic.

## Screens
- Messages: the list of voice messages, newest first, each with its topic, date and a player, and a topic filter above them (All, Ideas, Questions or News).
- Record: a Record button that becomes Stop while recording, a topic choice (Ideas, Questions, News) and a Save button.

## Data it keeps
- Voice messages: the recording, its topic and the date it was recorded.

examples.name: sketch wall with suggested tags (AI)
examples.spec:
# Sketch Wall

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  wall[Wall] -->|take a photo| add[Add a sketch]
  add -->|AI suggests tags| tags[Tags field]
  tags -->|keep or change, then Save| sketches[(Sketches)]
  sketches --> wall
```

## What it does
A shared wall of the team's sketches. Someone signed in to the workshop takes a photo of a sketch with the phone camera (or picks one from the phone). Right after the photo is saved, the app asks the workshop's AI to suggest tags for it and puts them in the tags field; the person keeps, changes or removes them and presses Save. When the AI is not available, the person types the tags. The wall shows the sketches as thumbnails, newest first, each with its tags.

## Screens
- Wall: thumbnails of all sketches, newest first, each with its tags.
- Add a sketch: a button to take or pick a photo, a tags field (separated by commas) filled with the AI's suggested tags, and a Save button.

## Data it keeps
- Sketches: the photo, its tags and the date it was added.

examples.name: expense log that reads receipts (AI)
examples.spec:
# Expense Log

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  list[Expenses] -->|photo of a receipt| add[Add an expense]
  add -->|AI reads shop, date and total| form[Expense form]
  form -->|check or correct, then Save| expenses[(Expenses)]
  expenses --> list
```

## What it does
A shared log of the team's expenses. Someone signed in to the workshop takes a photo of a receipt with the phone camera. Right after the photo is saved, the app asks the workshop's AI to read the shop, the date and the total from the receipt and fills the form with them; the person checks or corrects them and presses Save. When the AI is not available, the person types them. The expenses screen lists the expenses, newest first, each with its shop, date, total and a thumbnail of the receipt, and shows the sum of all totals.

## Screens
- Expenses: the list of expenses, newest first, each with shop, date, total and the receipt's thumbnail, and the sum of all totals.
- Add an expense: a button to take a photo of the receipt, fields for shop, date and total filled with what the AI read, and a Save button.

## Data it keeps
- Expenses: the receipt photo, the shop, the date, the total and its currency.
